Subject: Request: evaluation credit top-up + license waiver for Novara Health

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at Novara (ML and product) are excited about Redwood's latency profile. We have a security review in progress and procurement asked whether we can: 

- extend the current 14‑day trial by 30 days,
- add $12k in evaluation credits to cover higher token volumes during the extended test, and
- include a temporary license waiver so we can run on our isolated staging cluster while we finalize paperwork (legal says a waiver note is sufficient rather than a full addendum for this short period).

Rationale: we have a broader pilot scoped for Q4 that could convert to a $150k ARR contract. We need the extra run time and credits to validate throughput at peak loads. Procurement needs an internal approval note from Redwood to proceed on their side.

I've attached our trial requirements matrix (novara_trial_requirements.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate this exception, and what approvals you'll need?

Best,

Team — forwarding Novara's ask. TL;DR:
- Request: +$12k eval credit, extend trial 30 days, temporary license waiver for staging cluster (waiver text pending).
- Upside: Projected ARR ~$150k if pilot converts.
- Risk: temporary staging access; legal prefers a short signed waiver note instead of modifying the master agreement for a short period.

Key numbers and considerations:
- Current pilot consumption estimate: ~600k tokens/day at peak.
- Proposed credits: $12,000 (one-off evaluation credit).
- If we approve, we should attach a short conditional note: credits applied if pilot remains active and no abuse observed; waiver expires automatically once contract signed or the trial ends.

Asks:
1) Ben / Marissa — can we get exec signoff on the combined credit + waiver exception? If so, what approvals do you want added to the HubSpot deal and the commerce note? (Need a named exec signer for legal.)
2) Monica — confirm technical acceptability (are there any infra objections to a short staging waiver).

I've attached Novara_SOW_draft.docx and their requirements matrix.

Thanks,
Mateo

Mateo / Marissa — reviewed. Approve on the condition that:

- Credit cap is hard limited to $12k and expires if pilot is inactive for >7 days,
- Waiver is a one‑paragraph signed statement (legal to approve wording) and explicitly time‑boxed to the extended trial period (30 days), and
- Commerce adds a note requiring automatic rollback if metrics indicate misuse.

Recommend signatory: Marissa Cole (VP Sales) for exec approval. Marissa — can you confirm you’ll sign the waiver note if Legal signs off on the text? If you approve, I’ll mark the deal as exception_approved in HubSpot and route the DocuSign powerform for the waiver + credit confirmation.

Subject: Approved: evaluation credit top-up + conditional license waiver (Novara)

Hi Eli / Novara procurement — good news: we have internal approval to proceed with the exception under the conditions below.

What we agreed to grant:
- 30‑day trial extension starting when Novara confirms the activation date,
- One‑time $12,000 evaluation credit applied to usage while the extended trial is active,
- A temporary license waiver (one paragraph) that is time‑boxed to the extended trial and automatically rescinds when a commercial agreement is executed or the trial ends.

Conditions and next steps:
1) Legal needs a one‑paragraph waiver template from Novara or we can propose wording. Please confirm which you prefer.
2) The $12k credit is subject to an inactivity clause: if usage pauses >7 consecutive days, credit application will be reevaluated.
3) Marissa Cole (VP Sales) will sign the waiver note once Legal confirms the final text.
4) I will open a HubSpot exception record (deal NV-2027-0421) and attach the waiver + SOW.
5) Procurement: please complete the short DocuSign form here to accept the credit/waiver: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&token=abcd1234

Attachments: proposed_license_addendum.pdf (draft waiver language).

Thanks — we’re excited to move this pilot forward. Please send the preferred waiver text or confirm you want Redwood to propose it.
